messages:
Anika P.: quick heads up — partnering with GCP + NVIDIA to open southamerica-east1 (Sao Paulo) marketplace listing and dedicated capacity. need quota approvals, marketplace onboarding checklist, and hardware entitlement confirmation. can owners weigh in?
Cheng L.: thanks — what GPU profile are we planning to certify for dedicated? a100s, a30s? also need expected qps and per-tenant capacity targets.
Anika P.: target for Q1: start with 4x A100 nodes reserved for early customers, fallback profile A30 for cost tier. QPS rough target: 250 reqs/s sustained at 16k token windows (batching).
Mike R.: pricing question — will marketplace show separate SKU for Dedicated vs Hosted? want to line up MSRP for channel partners.
Nate (CloudWave): we can push marketplace SKUs. CloudWave will help with quota petitions to GCP marketplace team — need the exact quota numbers and planned go-live date.
Sara G.: legal flag — Sao Paulo needs DPA + local AUP review. also confirm whether telemetry or logs will transit US; if so, customers may require SOC2+ data residency addendum.
NVIDIA-sales-bot: Pre-check: partner discount for A100 in latam requires signed LOI. I can inject the pre-approval if LOI signed this week.
Cheng L.: infra items: VPC peering diagram, egress estimate, and IAM service account that will be used by marketplace connector. also a terraform diff to apply. deploy-bot: Please paste the terraform module name.
deploy-bot: 
```
module "gcp-marketplace-southamerica" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood/modules/gcp-marketplace.git//region"
  region = "southamerica-east1"
  gpu_profile = "a100-80gb"
  dedicated_nodes = 4
}
```
Anika P.: natasha from GCP partner ops asked for quota request template — paste below and we'll fill then submit: 
```
project_id: redwood-prod-sao
requested_resources:
  - type: compute.googleapis.com/instance_groups
    quota: 8
  - type: compute.googleapis.com/accelerator_types
    accelerator: nvidia-tesla-a100
    quota: 8
justification: Support SaaS customers in Brazil region for low-latency inference. Initial commit: 4 dedicated nodes + burst to 8.
```
Cheng L.: I patched the kernel selection tests for A100 on the staging pool — passed perf smoke. will upload perf logs to the partnership folder.
Mike R.: ops: what approvals needed from revenue ops to publish marketplace pricing?
Nate (CloudWave): CloudWave legal will need a reseller addendum; I'll coordinate with Sara. For quota, I can open the GCP ticket once we finalize numbers.
Sara G.: I'll draft DPA addendum + reseller addendum. timeline: I can have drafts by Thu EOD if no unexpected clauses.
Anika P.: action items so far: (1) Cheng — finalize infra numbers + perf logs (due in 24h). (2) Nate — open GCP quota ticket when we confirm numbers (ready after Cheng). (3) Sara — DPA/reseller drafts (Thu EOD). (4) Mike — pricing SKU definitions (end of day). (5) NVIDIA-sales-bot — confirm LOI timeline.
NVIDIA-sales-bot: LOI template sent to Anika. expected turnaround 48-72h after signature.
Mike R.: blocker: channel partners want a pre-public pricing sheet for APAC/EMEA parity check. can we use the same USD SKU and region price adjustment later?
Cheng L.: technical question — will we do KV cache warmers for São Paulo? if yes we need warm-up scripts and a short maintenance window during cutover.
Anika P.: yes we'll include KV warmers; add to runbook.
Nate (CloudWave): propose partner call Fri 09:00 BRT to align GCP ops + NVIDIA + CloudWave + Redwood infra. can everyone make that?
Sara G.: good for me.
Mike R.: ok.
Cheng L.: Friday works.
Anika P.: OK scheduled — I'll send calendar invites and attach the quota template + terraform snippet + action tracker. tagging @here for urgency :exclamation: :brazil:
Mike R.: thanks — I'll prepare the preliminary MSRP spreadsheet and share before the call.
Cheng L.: once GCP quota is open, please drop the ticket link here. I'll watch and provide any missing technical context.
Nate (CloudWave): noted. will also pull partner onboarding checklist from marketplace team and post.
Sara G.: I'll include checklist items that require legal signoff.
Anika P.: thanks team — goal: submit quota + LOI + marketplace package by next Tue. will report progress after Fri call.
file_notes: conversation about Sao Paulo GCP marketplace + NVIDIA hardware partnership; includes terraform snippet and quota template
